issues.where: the storm from the left shoulder around to the bottom of the globe
issues.what: The shake reads as a conspicuous upright whirlpool with long, almost continuous white ribbons and a smooth horizontal band at the bottom. The target has a broader sweep made of much shorter, broken streaks and softly turbulent clouds, with more points of warm light carried inside the snow.
issues.fix: Keep the intended concealment of the miniature, but break the long bands into shorter staggered trails at different depths, soften the tight swirl at left, and add scattered warmer glints in the rolling lower cloud.

issues.where: the cottage roof, chimney, door and front wall (crop 2; also B)
issues.what: The roof is wider and higher, the chimney sits higher, and the masonry reads as strongly shaded rounded blocks instead of the target's finer, flatter stonework. The broad dark door surround, larger window panes and brighter beadlike eave bulbs change the facade in both frames.
issues.fix: Lower and narrow the roof and chimney slightly, use finer flatter stone with less contrast, tighten the arched door surround and window proportions, and reduce the size and intensity of the eave bulbs.

issues.where: the tree crown, trunk and lights (crop 3; also B where visible)
issues.what: Snow sits in separate chunky caps, and the crown is more sharply segmented. The trunk looks like a bundle of bright, straight orange ribs, and tightly packed round bulbs are conspicuous beneath each tier. The target has more integrated snow along the boughs, a darker, curved and knotted trunk, and softer individual lights.
issues.fix: Blend the snow into the contours of the branches, give the trunk fewer and more naturally curving dark-grained limbs, and vary and soften the bulbs without reducing the intended storm cover in B.

issues.where: the top and shoulders of the glass and the lower interior rim (crops 1, 2 and 5; also B)
issues.what: The top dimple is larger and more conspicuous, the inner right reflection is thicker and softer at the end, and frost forms sharp, repeated fern-shaped patches over a relatively even pale rim. The target has a more defined reflection edge, deeper blue secondary reflections and frost that breaks up more organically into the rim and snowbank.
issues.fix: Shrink the top mark, refine the silhouette of the white right reflection and restore the blue inner refraction. Break up the frost patches and blend them into the glass and uneven snowbank rather than leaving hard stamped shapes.

issues.where: the glass seat, upper brass lip, and ice hanging from it (crops 4–5; also B)
issues.what: The glass sits above a thick exposed brass ring and a second clean lip, reading as two separate rails. Irregular granular snow partly buries the finer seat in the target, and its icicles are more translucent, individually tapered and variably spaced.
issues.fix: Lower the glass into a thinner collar, interrupt the exposed rails with more finely textured snow, and vary icicle outlines and clarity while bringing back the small transmitted highlights.

issues.where: the carved apron and braided foot (crops 4–6; also B)
issues.what: The front relief has a different silhouette, with fine scrollwork and a deeper pointed center instead of the fuller overlapping bronze leaves. The right side looks broadly powdered blue, and the foot trim is darker and more sharply outlined than the warmer, worn metal on the target.
issues.fix: Rebuild the fuller leaf relief and pinecone grouping, concentrate the cool light near the right edge, and bring warm worn highlights and a softer transition back to the braided foot and the lower metal band.

issues.where: the tabletop directly below the base and the snow at either side (crop 6 and full frame; also B)
issues.what: The reflected gold foot becomes two clean parallel lines, with a particularly legible return at lower left. Side frost is flatter and whiter, spreading in graphic, jagged patches. The target reflection fades into dark blue and warm flecks and is broken by thicker, granular snow and delicate fernlike crystals.
issues.fix: Diffuse and interrupt the reflected trim, recover the scattered amber and cool highlights, and replace the flat white patches with irregular granular clumps and fine frost fronds.

issues.where: the pond, shore, and fence in front of the cottage (crops 2 and 5)
issues.what: The pond reads as a flatter, squarer cutout with an abrupt dark bank and broad yellow sheen instead of a rounded blue, textured pool with a concentrated lamp glint. The fence has heavy rails and posts where the target has slender, individually readable uprights.
issues.fix: Round and roughen the snowy bank, restore the fine cool-blue ice texture and compact warm reflection, and make the fence taller and finer with narrower rails, posts and balusters.

issues.where: the lamp and adjacent cottage lights during the shake (crop 2)
issues.what: A large diffuse yellow bloom centers on the lamp and washes across the cottage windows and pond. The target retains a distinct lantern light and a warmer, more diffuse glow spread low through the snow.
issues.fix: Tighten the source glow around the lantern and windows, then spread the warmer scattered light lower through the moving snow without making the miniature more visible overall.

issues.where: the out-of-focus lights behind both shoulders (also B)
issues.what: The high-right blue disc is larger and more saturated, and the warm light left of the globe is a little higher and broader. The targets have slightly finer discs and warmer rims on the upper-right pair.
issues.fix: Reduce the upper-right disc slightly, restore its warm edge and move the left amber light a little lower, without reintroducing the settled background artifacts.
